name: Dev Tools
description: Runs offline in a sandbox with zero network calls and just a single local permission. 42 developer utilities in ~150KB: an all-in-one toolkit covering crypto & security, encoding, text & regex, time & Cron, network & DevOps, and frontend assets—built for everyday development needs.
releaseNotes: Two new tools (42 total, ~150KB): HTTP helper (raw headers ⇄ JSON + status code/header reference) and a CSS generator (gradients, box-shadow, live preview). Time tool gains timezone conversion with bare-offset input (+8, UTC+8) and a local-zone shortcut; color gains harmony palettes; case converter gains URL slugs; ID generator gains deterministic UUID v5/v3. UI: 23 consolidated category chips capped at two rows, collapsible all-tools grids, privacy switch for recents, favorites empty-state card, persisted typewriter toggle, ⌘K/Ctrl+K search focus.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 沙箱离线运行，零联网、仅1项本地权限。42 款开发工具仅 ~150KB：集安全加解密、编解码与转义、文本与正则排版、时间与 Cron 计算、网络与系统运维、前端图像与标识生成等全场景工具于一体，满足日常开发高频需求。
